subject: Decision Making
subcategory: The Science of Risk and Reward
title: Scenario Planning
description: Learn Scenario Planning in one minute.

hook.text: Shell Oil survived the 1973 oil crisis because it had already planned for that scenario. Competitors were blindsided.

buildup.text: Scenario planning creates multiple plausible futures and prepares responses for each. It does not predict; it prepares.

discovery.text: The method works by forcing decision-makers to imagine worlds they prefer not to think about. Discomfort is the point.

twist.text: Scenarios are not forecasts. Assigning probabilities defeats the purpose.

climax.text: Scenario Planning matters because structure beats guesswork when stakes are high.

punchline.text: Scenario Planning: good judgment beats certainty every time.

quiz.question: How did scenario planning help Shell Oil?
options: They predicted the exact crisis date
They had already prepared responses for an oil crisis scenario before it happened
